t: The $(item)Liquid Hopper/$ is a device which you can use to transfer fluids. Like the $(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)Omnidirectional Hopper/$, its input and output can point in any direction, and it uses the same placement and rotation rules. You can add $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed Upgrades/$ to increase the transfer rate.
$(item)流体漏斗/$是一种可用于传输流体的装置。和$(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)全向漏斗/$一样，它的输入端和输出端可以朝向任意方向，并且使用相同的放置与旋转规则。你可以加入$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度升级/$来提高传输速率。

The $(item)Liquid Hopper/$ will also attempt to drain fluids from any items on the ground in front of its $(9)input/$ side and to insert fluids into any items in front of its $(6)output/$ side, e.g. water buckets, lava buckets or modded fluid containers.
$(item)流体漏斗/$还会尝试从其$(9)输入/$侧前方地面上的任何物品中抽取流体，并将流体注入其$(6)输出/$侧前方的任何物品中，例如水桶、熔岩桶或模组添加的流体容器。

If a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$ is inserted into the $(item)Liquid Hopper/$, it can absorb any liquid block (1000mB) at the $(9)input/$ side, and dispense 1000mB of any stored liquid at the $(6)output/$ side. This can be used for example as a water pump.$(p)It can also absorb any $(item)Experience Orbs/$ at the input side, converting them to $(l:base_concepts/memory_essence)Memory Essence/$.

如果将$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$插入$(item)流体漏斗/$，它会吸取$(9)输入/$侧的任意液体方块（1000mB），并在$(6)输出/$侧放出 1000mB 的任意已储存液体。例如，它可以用作水泵。$(p)它还能吸收$(9)输入/$侧的任意$(item)经验球/$，并将其转化为$(l:base_concepts/memory_essence)记忆源质/$。
